scenario_description: The identical hostile workload rejects a deliberately inherited network boundary.
expected: Baseline behavior still passes, isolating the difference to the execution boundary.
At least one egress attempt succeeds and the hostile assertion exits nonzero.
The following sentinel is not run and cleanup is still confirmed.
observed: Preparation, baseline unittest, behavior artifact, image, commit, and hostile command argv matched the production experiment.
With inherited networking, both direct IP and DNS egress were true and the exact hostile assertion exited one.
The following boundary sentinel was retained as not run; the host stayed unchanged and SWE-ReX removed the container.
notes: PASS means the paired unsafe control was detected; the unisolated execution itself failed the boundary contract as designed.
